node.title: XR split-pencil rank anomalies contain explicit dual-product-code trades
node.statement: Every nonzero left-kernel relation in a bounded split-pencil Maxwell core is a family of dual cubic-evaluation words lambda_i satisfying sum lambda_i=sum gamma_i lambda_i=0. On a block A_i of size 4+c_i, lambda_i(x)=P_i(x)/Lambda'_Ai(x) with deg P_i<c_i, so every active block has weight at least five. At every active coordinate at least three distinct slopes occur, and the coefficients have the dual-RS_2 form Q_x(gamma_i)/product_(j!=i)(gamma_i-gamma_j), deg Q_x<|I_x|-2. Thus every counterexample contains a bounded (block-degree at least 5, coordinate-degree at least 3) dual-product-code trade. This is a normal form, not a trade classification.
